loading.assembly_sequence: Slotted liners first; magnets then combined rear plugs/baffles; preassembled contact module afterward. Whole master geometry and received parts still require parent checks.

closed_finite_ray_screen.method: Finite opaque-solid mesh ray screen with segment/triangle BVH acceleration, every apparent clear segment rechecked against exact BRep. No all-ray proof, reflections, transmission or measured optical attenuation.
closed_finite_ray_screen.seam_targets: 6samples per straight/12per quadrant,3seamZ at40.01/40.15/40.29; plus free sampled hinge-eye annulusR4.4 and bore-endR1.6. Each interior-to-aperture direction is continued500mm beyond its aperture; endpoint height varies with ray slope.
